chart.title: Democracy Index
chart.subtitle: Data by Polity 5. Expert estimates of the extent to which open, multi-party, and competitive elections choose a chief executive who faces comprehensive institutional constraints, and political participation is competitive. The index ranges from -10 to 10 (fully democratic).
chart.citation: Polity 5 (2020); Population based on various sources (2023)

Democracy.descriptionShort:
It combines information on the extent to which open, multi-party, and competitive elections choose a chief executive who faces comprehensive institutional constraints, and political participation is competitive.

It ranges from -10 to 10 (fully democratic).
Democracy.descriptionKey: We have other democracy data sources that also cover more recent years and have more precise data. You can find them in our [Key Democracy Charts](https://ourworldindata.org/democracy#all-charts) and [Democracy Data Explorer](https://ourworldindata.org/explorers/democracy).
Democracy.descriptionProcessing:
Values for continents have been obtained using two different methodologies:
- Averaging the values of the countries in the continent. E.g. labeled as "Africa".
- Averaging the values of the countries in the continent _weighed by each country's population_. E.g. labeled as "Africa (population-weighted)".
